title: Bolt

fields.name: Bolt
fields.description: An arrow-like projectile used by crossbows. Mostly made out of carbon fiber, apart from the steel point and the plastic fletching.

intro: Bolt is a type of Crossbow ammunition in DayZ. It is a manufactured bolt with a modern steel broadhead tip for big-game hunting.

title: Bone Arrow

fields.description: Carefully crafted arrow made out of a chicken feather, stick and bone head.

intro: The Bone Arrow was a type of ammunition in DayZ used with the Improvised Ashwood Short Bow. It is currently not enabled.

title: Composite Arrow

fields.description: Top grade composite arrow.

intro: The Composite Arrow is a type of ammunition in DayZ used with the Improvised Ashwood Short Bow. It is currently not spawning.

title: Cupid's Bolt

fields.name: Cupid's Bolt
fields.description: An arrow-like projectile used by crossbows. Made out of pure love and finished with a heart-shaped broadhead. It can be used to spread love.

intro: The Cupid's Bolt is a type of Crossbow ammunition in DayZ. It is a seasonal item related to the Valentine's Day event.

title: Flare

fields.description: Signal flare cartridge. Used in a signal pistol, it contains a mix of chemicals, making them shine with a bright light.

intro: The Flare round is a type of ammunition in DayZ. It is used via the Signal Pistol to create a light source. When fired from the signal pistol it will cast a bright light in the colour of the round either red, green, blue or yellow upto 100 meters radius for around 35 seconds before disappearing.

title: Improvised Bolt

fields.name: Improvised Bolt
fields.description: An arrow-like projectile used by crossbows. Made out of necessity and a bit of goodwill. It won't exactly kill a bear, but it will do its job.

intro: The Improvised Bolt is an ammunition for the Crossbow in DayZ. It is craftable by combining a Short Stick with any knife. It can be upgraded by combining it with Chicken Feathers to make an Improvised Bolt (feathered). title: Improvised Bolt (feathered)

fields.name: Improvised Bolt (feathered)
fields.description: An arrow-like projectile used by crossbows. Made out of necessity and a bit of goodwill. It won't exactly kill a bear, but it will do its job.

intro: The Improvised Bolt (feathered) is an ammunition for the Crossbow in DayZ. It is crafted by combining the Improvised Bolt with Chicken Feathers. The feathered bolt is faster and much more accurate than the crude Improvised Bolt, while being slightly heavier and more fragile.
